question: Does a verdict ever report a value it cannot justify as inside a rating?
reading: On every finite number the two predicates agree exactly, so this changes no real design. They differ only where the value is not a number - and there the live predicate answers INSIDE THE RATING, because a comparison against NaN is false. A tool that signs designs off may return an error or a fail; it must never return a pass it cannot justify.
not_claimed: This gate checks a comparison, not a design. It says nothing about whether the limits themselves are right, and nothing about any physics.
anonymised: No project, site, maker or model anywhere.
